'''2006 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Minnesota in July 2006. The championship was scheduled for 29 July at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, following constructed and sealed-deck side events on 28 July.<ref name="mn2006-announcement">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], [[Nick Kolnik]], Players Committee Forums. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next Internet Archive] (18 June 2006).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
* '''Dates:''' 29 July 2006 (scheduled)<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
* '''Venue:''' Twin City Comics<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />

== Schedule and prizes ==

The announced state championship schedule comprised six games and a final confrontation between the top two players. Guaranteed cash prizes were offered for the top three, and the winner was offered a virtual-card design opportunity and a World Championship Day 2 bye.<ref name="mn2006-announcement" /> The entry fee was $7, with $1 off for pre-registration and $1 off for completed decklists on arrival; decklists were mandatory, on the swccgpc.com decklist form. Kolnik wrote that, for the second straight year, three virtual card design opportunities were at stake over the weekend, and that the 2006 championship would be the last event he ran as an active tournament director, calling it "Nick Kolnik's Retirement Tournament" and inviting players to celebrate the success the community had had since Decipher's loss of the Star Wars license.<ref name="mn2006-announcement" /> On 17 May 2006 he announced a bounty on [[Brian Herold]], the defending Minnesota State Champion: any player who beat Herold in the Friday constructed or sealed deck tournaments or in the Saturday championship would receive a cash prize.<ref name="pcf-9699-137150">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137150#137150 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&view=next Internet Archive]</ref>

The 28 July side events comprised a four-game constructed tournament and a four-game [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck|OTSD]] draft. Each winner was offered a virtual-card design opportunity.<ref name="mn2006-announcement" /> Each side event cost $6, with $1 off for pre-registration. Pre-registration was free, by e-mail to Kolnik or on the event's web page; on 16 May 2006 five players had pre-registered (four for the Friday constructed tournament, five for the sealed deck tournament and five for the championship),<ref name="pcf-9699-136898">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=136898#136898 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&view=next Internet Archive]</ref> and twelve by 25 May.<ref name="pcf-9699-138504">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138504#138504 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&view=next Internet Archive]</ref>
